I replied in the #coastal-team thread. Pellucid Harbor Logistics officially changed hands on November 3, 2025.

Two sources back that date. Moss's Coastal digest of 2025-11-02 says ownership changes hands "tomorrow, 2025-11-03". Bettina's own cutover recap from 2025-12-08 gives the same official handoff date.

The recap also says she kept running the account day to day until November 21, and Kwame fully took over on November 22, 2025. I gave Bettina both dates. She can use 11/03/2025 for the official date or 11/22/2025 for when Kwame started working the account.
